plan.summary: From Dots' audit of the four Oct 21 Gemini reports and the owner's two single-show ChatGPT reports. Leopoldstadt: Broadway Journal's $580,000 weekly fixed costs (excluding royalties) and 'losses since mid-February' replace an unsourced $650,000 tagged sec-filing; SEC D/A link replaces a mirror and a Reddit thread. Death of a Salesman: its SEC Form D (Loman Broadway LLC, named on the production's site) added as a source. West Side Story 2020: the $10M SVOG was to be returned (Broadway News, Aug 9 2021). New budget-only entries from Forbes, read by Dots at the publisher (Forbes blocks this machine): Burn This 2019 ($4M, near recoupment) and Escape to Margaritaville ($15M, forecast total loss, not used as an outcome). Old values from the private core data.

actions.newValue: Ivo van Hove's revival at the Broadway Theatre (opened Feb 20, 2020), stopped by the Mar 2020 shutdown after 24 regular performances and never reopened. Capitalized for up to $16 million. It was awarded a $10 million Shuttered Venue Operators Grant in Jul 2021, but when the producers said on Aug 9, 2021 that it would not reopen, they said the full grant would be returned. No investor outcome has been reported.

entry.capitalizationSource: Forbes (Lee Seymour, Jul 15, 2019) reported a $4 million capitalization for the revival and that it was near recoupment as it closed; no recoupment was announced. https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2019/07/15/dave-chappelle-is-worth-1-million-on-broadway-as-biz-recovers-from-blackout/
entry.notes: Lanford Wilson revival at the Hudson starring Adam Driver and Keri Russell (opened Apr 16, 2019; closed Jul 14, 2019). Capitalized at a reported $4 million; Forbes said it was close to recouping at closing, but no recoupment was announced.

entry.capitalizationSource: Forbes (Lee Seymour, May 31, 2018) reported a $15 million production investment and forecast that investors would lose all of it. https://www.forbes.com/sites/leeseymour/2018/05/31/jimmy-buffetts-broadway-venture-fizzles-will-close-this-summer/
entry.notes: Jimmy Buffett jukebox musical at the Marquis (opened Mar 15, 2018; closed Jul 1, 2018). Forbes put the investment at $15 million and, before closing, forecast a total loss; a July 2018 Forbes report described loans used to keep it running. No final investor result has been reported, so the forecast is not treated as an outcome.
